system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Retrieves the complete payment history of the farmer under PM-KISAN, including all past installments (₹2000 each, 3 per year totaling ₹6000/year), their dates, amounts, and transaction statuses. Here are my details: my aadhaar_number is 100020001959.

function.name: pmkisan_get_payment_history
function.description: Retrieves the complete payment history of the farmer under PM-KISAN, including all past installments (₹2000 each, 3 per year totaling ₹6000/year), their dates, amounts, and transaction statuses. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT show upcoming or pending installments — use pmkisan_track_installment_status for that. Fails if the farmer is not registered. Returns empty history if no payments have been processed yet.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
